jobs.title: Sales Data Analyst | SQL, BigQuery & Dashboards
jobs.description:
**Are you a SQL\-fluent analyst who can look at a raw BigQuery table and turn it into an answer a sales leader can act on the same day?**

**Are you someone who instinctively distrusts a number until you've traced exactly which model it came from and what grain it's sitting at?**

**Are you comfortable using AI tools like Claude Code every single day to write, debug, and ship SQL faster — not just someone who says they're "open to" AI?**

**We are My Derma Dream! A nearly 9\-figure Skin Care brand in the United States since 2022\.**

**We are continuing to scale quickly and hiring across multiple functions across the business.**

**BUT…**

**We do not need an analyst who waits for someone to ask a question before opening BigQuery.**

**We need someone who goes looking for the story in the data before anyone asks for it.**

**We are looking for a Sales Data Analyst who can specialize in the full sales side of the business: bundles, DTC order economics, subscriptions and churn, product profitability, and phone sales team performance.**

**In order to achieve this, you will work directly inside our dbt\-modeled BigQuery gold layer, building dashboards from scratch in areas where none exist today — starting with bundle performance and phone sales optimization.**

**You will use AI tools like Claude Code and text\-to\-SQL copilots daily to move faster than a traditional analyst workflow allows, and you'll work across our homegrown BI stack (Metabase, Looker Studio, and whatever else gets added) without needing months of ramp\-up on a new tool.**

**If you love turning a messy transactional dataset into a number a sales leader trusts enough to act on...**

**If you want to be the person who finally builds the dashboards that don't exist yet, not maintain ones that already do...**

**If you're an AI\-native analyst who moves noticeably faster because of it...**

 **Then APPLY NOW!**

 **\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=**

**Results:**

* **Dashboards and analyses that sales and ops leadership actually use to make calls — not reports that sit unread.**
* **A real bundle\-performance story (which tiers convert, where bundles cannibalize each other) built from data that already exists but has never been turned into an answer.**
* **Subscription and churn reporting that correctly separates true churn from payments rescued through payment\-retry recovery — not a naive rebill count.**
* **Phone sales performance analysis that tells reps and managers exactly what separates the best performers from the rest.**
* **A gold\-layer query and dashboard footprint sales leadership can rely on without needing to check your work.**

 **\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Own SQL\-based analysis across bundles, DTC order economics, subscriptions, churn, product profitability, and phone sales performance.**
* **Build the first real bundle\-performance dashboard from data that already exists in our BigQuery gold layer.**
* **Build the first phone sales performance dashboard, using rep\-level and funnel\-level data.**
* **Build the MRR waterfall (new, expansion, contraction, churn) and cohort retention views from scratch.**
* **Correctly separate true churn from payments rescued through our payment\-retry / involuntary\-churn recovery flow.**
* **Analyze order\-line\-level revenue, discounts, and reversals to explain margin swings before finance has to flag them.**
* **Own unit\-economics analysis by product and by cohort, incorporating COGS and commission.**
* **Use AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and text\-to\-SQL copilots daily to write, debug, and ship SQL and dashboards faster.**
* **Work directly inside a dbt\-modeled gold layer — understand model lineage and grain well enough to know which mart actually answers which question.**
* **Build self\-serve dashboards and saved queries so sales leadership can answer their own questions without pinging you for every cut of the data.**
* **Work across our homegrown BI stack (Metabase, Looker Studio, and whatever else gets added) without needing months of ramp\-up on a new tool.**
* **Flag data\-quality issues and anomalies before they reach sales or finance leadership.**
* **Manage multiple concurrent analysis requests while maintaining accuracy and speed.**
* **Provide regular updates on what you're finding, what's blocked, and what needs a decision.**

 **\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=\=**

**Requirements:**

* **3\+ years of hands\-on SQL analysis against a real production warehouse (BigQuery strongly preferred), ideally against order, subscription, or payment data.**
* **AI\-native in practice: you can point to a real example of using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar to ship a SQL model or dashboard faster.**
* **Comfortable working directly in a dbt\-modeled gold layer — reading model lineage and understanding grain.**
* **Experience analyzing subscription businesses: MRR movements, cohort retention, churn definitions, payment\-retry/recovery flows.**
* **Comfortable across a homegrown, evolving BI stack (Metabase, Looker Studio, and more as it's added), including building one\-off dashboards yourself using Claude Code.**
* **Experience with large, messy transactional datasets — order systems, payment processors, or subscription billing platforms. CheckoutChamp or Shopify experience is a plus but not required.**
* **Strong written communication — comfortable explaining a nuanced number to a non\-technical sales leader, and "trust me" isn't an answer we accept.**
* **Highly organized, disciplined, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent analyses at once.**
* **Strong figure\-it\-out ability — comfortable defining a metric before anyone hands you a spec for it.**
* **Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field preferred, not required — equivalent hands\-on experience is a real substitute, not a lesser one.**
* **Experience working with CheckoutChamp, Aircall, or similar order/phone systems is advantageous.**
* **Work 6 days/week.**
* **Work 10 hours/day.**
*

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Analyst and Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Biner Consulting works at the intersection of business and IT. We help organisations lead their digital change.


We are looking for a business analyst for an assignment with one of our clients in Gothenburg, a global financial services company and part of a leading Swedish industrial group. The client runs three global platforms that manage customer contracts, loans, leases and rentals across markets in Europe, Africa and Asia Pacific. Each has grown its own way of writing requirements, testing and releasing. Your job is to understand all three, write specifications that hold across them, and bring the ways of working closer together.


You are employed as a consultant with Biner and step straight into the assignment with the client. The role is on site in Gothenburg, the client does not work with remote or hybrid setups. The assignment can, over time, move into permanent employment with the client.

**What you will do**

* Lead process analysis, workshops, gap assessments and requirements gathering, and translate business needs into functional solution designs and acceptance criteria.
* Own the requirement through its whole life, from the first business conversation to the tested and released solution.
* Drive roadmap planning, platform standardisation, cross\-market alignment and adoption strategies across the three platforms, and ensure compliance, governance and business value realisation.
* Act as the key interface between stakeholders, product owners, markets and vendors, prioritise requirements and coordinate delivery activities.
* Lead UAT, business acceptance, release sign\-off and solution validation, and make sure delivered capabilities meet business objectives.
* Compare how the three platforms handle the same process, for example invoice testing, and propose one common way of doing it.
* Build high\-level knowledge across multiple CMS platforms, identify optimisation opportunities and drive process improvements globally.
* Support market rollouts and migrations, and produce documentation, process flows and specifications that hold up for reuse.

**Who you are**

* Seven to ten years in business analysis, requirements engineering or a similar role in complex IT delivery, ideally in financial services.
* You write requirements and specifications that hold up under scrutiny from both business and development.
* You know testing from the inside, including scenarios, validation criteria, regression and UAT.
* You are technically literate and comfortable discussing integrations, data flows and configuration with technical teams.
* You are curious about how a business actually works and you ask until you understand it.
* You work independently, take end to end ownership and adapt easily when the structure is still being formed.
* You are fluent in both Swedish and English, in writing and in person.

**Merits**

* Asset finance, leasing, rental, contract management or payments.
* Finance and CMS platforms such as Aryza, FIS, Alfa, Solifi, Sofico or Oracle.
* Configuration experience, data mapping and integration requirements.
* Data validation, for example through SQL based checks.
* Multi market rollouts, system migrations, and agile frameworks such as SAFe.

**Why Biner**


With us you never stop developing. You work side by side with experienced consultants and take on new challenges that sharpen you both technically and commercially. We share knowledge generously, because when you grow, we grow together.

**Application**


Gothenburg, on site. The client operates on site, so remote and hybrid setups are not applicable. Applications are reviewed continuously, so send yours as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern SE – Stockholm and Gothenburg
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------



Arthur D. Little is accepting applications for spring 2027 internships at our Stockholm and Gothenburg office lasting between approximately 3 and 5 months. We are looking for talented students with a genuine interest in strategy and management consulting. For the right candidate, we can provide a unique opportunity to learn and grow in a highly innovative and driven work environment. You will work as a junior team member in challenging client assignments together with experienced consultants that will provide guidance and help you develop.  

Arthur D. Little is a global management consulting firm supporting leading corporations and organizations to link strategy, technology, and innovation. Arthur D. Little, the world’s first management consultancy, was founded in **1886** and celebrates its **140th anniversary this year**. Today, Arthur D. Little has 51 offices across 39 countries, including Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Oslo. Arthur D. Little works within all major industries and has outstanding expertise within the fields of strategy, future of operations, and innovation
**Responsibilities**
--------------------



As an Intern at Arthur D. Little, you will:
* Use strong quantitative and analytical abilities to integrate and assess data
* Develop customized analysis tools
* Synthesize analytical results to provide action\-oriented recommendations
* Work with clients and team members to develop and implement innovative solutions
* Take initiative in both client engagements and internal projects
* Communicate results and discuss issues with project teams and, on occasion, clients
* Gain immediate responsibility for project deliverables

The role requires a high level of creative thinking and problem solving, combined with strong quantitative, interpersonal and team\-working skills.
**Qualifications**
------------------



We are looking for candidates with sharp analytical skills, creativity, drive, excellent communication skills and a team\-oriented spirit. Internship candidates should have completed their Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, or similar with excellent results. Fluency in Swedish and English is a requirement.  

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. We are flexible regarding the start date. If you have questions, please direct your enquiries to se.careers@adlittle.com  

**Please provide your application in English including CV and cover letter as well as high school and university grades (incl. current GPA)**

jobs.title: Credit Risk Management & Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About the Role**


We are looking for an analyst with strong business capabilities to join our team. This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of data analysis and business decision\-making. You will analyse our performing credit portfolios, evaluate and improve pre\-collection activities, and provide analytical support for portfolio sales and transactions across our markets.


You will work with everything from SQL\-based data analysis and performance monitoring to presenting clear recommendations to business owners and management. We are looking for someone who does not stop at explaining what happened, but can identify why it happened and what we should do next.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse the performance of performing credit portfolios, including payment behaviour, early delinquency, roll rates, vintages, customer segments and profitability
* Identify emerging risks and opportunities and translate findings into concrete business recommendations
* Measure and improve pre\-collection strategies, including customer selection, contact channels, treatment strategies, vendor performance and cure rates
* Design and evaluate tests to determine the incremental impact of pre\-collection initiatives
* Develop robust SQL analyses, datasets and recurring performance reporting
* Support portfolio sales and forward\-flow transactions through portfolio segmentation, data\-tape preparation, cash\-flow and pricing analyses, due diligence and post\-sale performance monitoring
* Ensure strong data quality, consistent definitions and clear documentation
* Present findings in a concise and commercially relevant way to business stakeholders, committees and management
* Collaborate with colleagues across Credit Risk, Collections, Finance, Commercial \& Data as well as country teams and external partners

##### **Qualifications and Experience**

* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large and complex datasets
* A relevant academic background in finance, economics, statistics, mathematics, data science or a similar quantitative field
* Experience within credit risk, portfolio analytics, consumer finance, collections or another data\-driven financial environment
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, combined with commercial judgement
* Ability to turn complex analyses into clear conclusions and practical recommendations
* A structured and independent working style, with strong attention to data quality and detail
* Strong communication skills and confidence working with both technical and business stakeholders
* Professional proficiency in English
* Experience with Power BI, advanced Excel, pre\-collection, portfolio sales or debt\-purchase transactions is a plus

**We Offer**  

You will join a developing Group function with a clear mandate and close access to decision\-makers. The role offers broad exposure across markets and products, significant ownership of your analyses and the opportunity to directly influence how we manage portfolio performance, prevent future credit losses and execute portfolio transactions.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Payroll, Rostering & Finance
jobs.description:
**Help shape the payroll and finance solutions of the future for the public sector in Denmark. At EG, we're looking for a Business Analyst who can translate complex needs into smart, simple solutions**.


EG has an ambition to be Denmark's most valuable partner in the public sector. We develop and operate software in areas that support payroll administration, organizational structure and financial management for customers in the public sector in Denmark. Regions and municipalities have a strong focus on efficiency, and this is where our solutions have a role.


We work continuously with a strong focus on quality, modernization and development of our software so that it supports the customers' needs in the best possible way. You will be part of a strong team that solves exciting development tasks of high quality and focuses on the utilization of AI.

**As part of the department**  

You will be part of a team that maintains and develops products and services for the portfolio within Payroll and Finance.


As a Business Analyst, you will have a close dialogue with our customers and our customer support. A close dialogue is an important prerequisite for understanding the customers' needs and prioritizing our efforts in the development department. You will be the translator between technology and requirements.

**Your role: Translate, Align and Deliver**  

You will have the opportunity to work with many complex issues, where you actively contribute by using your toolbox to ensure the right and best solution for the customer.


The tasks are, for example:

* Understand the customer's work and the customer's requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into well\-described user stories with clear requirements that can be understood by your fellow developers.
* Align solutions with customers.
* Think about the use of AI to continuously optimize our working methods.
* Assess the impact on the customer on incidents and participate in the resolution.
* Continuously update documentation – both externally and internally.
* Prepare test cases and perform tests (system, integration and user tests).
* Facilitate and participate in workshops with clients.
* Provide input to the team's Product Owner regarding, among other things, prioritization and estimation of the tasks.

**You are the ideal candidate if you**  

Have a master's degree or a shorter higher education in Business or IT. Maybe HA/Cand.merc, Cand.merc. Mat or something completely different.


Maybe you are currently working in a municipality's Payroll and Finance department and want to try your hand at the IT side instead.


The most important thing is that you have the desire, energy and interest, and we will help you gain business knowledge.

**To be successful in the role, it is important that you:**

* Have strong analytical skills and have the courage to familiarize yourself with a complex area.
* See the use of AI as a positive opportunity and not a threat.
* Have good communication skills both in writing and orally.
* Can translate your experience in balancing business considerations and functional requirements in IT projects into concrete results.
* Strive to gain an understanding of Payroll, Financial Management and Bookkeeping.
* Can work both in close collaboration and independently and know when to seek help from colleagues.
* Are fluent in English both written and verbal.
* You are a team player who contributes with energy, humor and the will to succeed.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible working hours with the opportunity to organize your own time.
* Possibility of working from home.
* Ability to put your fingerprint on methods and your own tasks.
* The position is in an exciting company that is in rapid development and has a strong focus on AI.
* Attractive salary according to qualifications.
* Attractive lunch, fruit and coffee/tea scheme.
* Active staff association that organizes good social events.
* In\-house clinic with e.g. physiotherapist as a supplement to health insurance.
* Place of employment in Aarhus.

**Our Values**

* **Lead the Industry** \- We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* **Make it Happen** \- We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* **Stronger Together** \- We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**  

If you are interested in hearing more before applying, you are welcome to contact manager Lotte Jensen on phone \+45 3035 0840\. We evaluate the applications on an ongoing basis and hire when the right candidate has been found, so please send your application as soon as possible.

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**  

Our industry\-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.


Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security.


If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here. You'll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.


Join us in creating software that works for people \- not software that makes people work.


Curious what it's really like to work at EG?


Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: **Working at EG**


See all our open positions **here**.


Learn more about EG **here**.

jobs.title: Web Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

*Er du nysgerrig på data, digital måling og brugeradfærd? Brænder du for at hjælpe virksomheder med at forstå deres digitale performance og omsætte data til konkrete anbefalinger? Så er du måske vores nye Web Analytics Consultant.*

  

Vi søger en analytisk og løsningsorienteret profil til vores Analytics \& Data Solutions\-team i København. Du kommer til at arbejde med implementering af tracking, analyse af digitale data og rådgivning af nogle af Danmarks mest spændende virksomheder.


Rollen er ideel for dig, som har nogle års erfaring med webanalyse og tracking og ønsker at udvikle dig yderligere inden for digital measurement, analytics og datadrevet marketing.  

  

**Om rollen**  

Som Web Analytics Consultant bliver du en del af et specialiseret team, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, udviklere, marketing\-specialister og andre dataeksperter.


Du vil være med til at sikre, at vores kunder har det rette datagrundlag til at forstå brugeradfærd, måle marketingindsatser og træffe bedre forretningsbeslutninger.


Du får mulighed for at arbejde med både implementering, analyse og rådgivning på tværs af forskellige teknologier og platforme, samtidig med at du udvikler dine tekniske og forretningsmæssige kompetencer.  

  

Primære ansvarsområder

* Implementering og tracking: implementere og vedligeholde tracking\-løsninger på app, web og digitale platforme.
* Datakvalitet og governance: Validere og kvalitetssikre data, fejlfinde problemer og etablere best\-practices for datagovernance.
* Rådgivning: Være sparringspartner for kunder inden for digital måling og analytics og hjælpe med at omsætte forretningsmål til datadrevne løsninger.
* Indsigter og rapportering: Udvikle dashboards, rapporter og handlingsorienteret indsigter, som understøtter beslutningstagning på alle niveauer.
* Innovation og udvikling: Holde dig opdateret på udviklingen inden for measurement, privacy og teknologier samt bidrage med nye idéer til at styrke vores løsninger.

 **Om dig**


Vi forestiller os, at du har 2\-5 års erfaring inden for webanalyse, digital measurement eller tracking.

* Analyseekspertise: Solid praktisk erfaring med Google Analytics og Google Tag Manager eller lignende værktøjer.
* Tekniske færdigheder: Stærk forståelse af serverside\- og cloudløsninger. Kendskab til JavaScript, SQL og BigQuery er en fordel.
* Løsningsorienteret rådgiver: Kan identificere og løse komplekse trackingudfordringer og kommunikere løsningerne på en måde, der skaber værdi for forretningen.

 **Om dit fremtidige team**  

Du bliver en del af Analytics \& Data Solutions, hvor vi arbejder med analytics, tracking, måling, audiences, UX \& CRO og rådgivning på tværs af en bred portefølje af kunder. Vi værdsætter samarbejde, opfordrer til læring og skaber plads til, at du kan udvikle dine færdigheder, mens du forbliver i front i den stadigt udviklende verden af digital markedsføring.  

  

**Hvad tilbyder vi**

* En attraktiv pensionsordning samt sundhedsforsikring.
* Udviklings\- og karrieremuligheder.
* Lækker morgenmad og frokost fra vores egne kokke.
* Ubegrænset kaffe, te og gode kolleger.
* Sociale aktiviteter som vinklub, løbeklub, spilaftener og firmaevents.

 **Om os**


I dentsu rådgiver vi vores kunder \- på tværs af medier og marketing – ift. at styrke deres tilstedeværelse og relationer til deres kunder gennem stærke kommunikationsløsninger. Herigennem bidrager vi til, at vores kunder vækster deres forretning. På tværs af vores tre lines of business \- media, creative og customer experience \- samler vi de dygtigste eksperter inden for medier, strategi, kreativitet, performance, CXM, data og teknologi. Dentsu International har over 45\.000 ansatte i 143 lande. I Danmark er vi 550 dedikerede medarbejdere fordelt på vores kontorer i Christianshavn, Vesterbro og Aarhus. Danmark repræsenterer en række af vores globale brands hhv. Merkle, Carat, iProspect og dentsu X.

 **Inklusion og Diversitet:**


Hos dentsu tror vi på styrken i diversitet. Vi byder alle ansøgninger velkommen uanset alder, handicap, kønsskifte, civilstand, graviditet eller barsel, race, hudfarve, nationalitet, etnisk eller national oprindelse, religion eller tro, køn eller seksuel orientering.

 **Interesseret?**  

  

Send os dit CV og en motiveret ansøgning. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.  

  

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til Talent Acquisition Partner, Maryna Hytten på maryna.hytten@dentsu.com  

  

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
